clean-holdout: task first introduced after the freeze commit (taskCreatedAfterFreeze)
every core knowledge card first introduced after the freeze AND absent from the frozen skill tree (pre-freeze supporting citations are allowed and recorded with role=supporting)
core graded migration knowledge absent from the frozen skill corpus (no equivalent recipe / exact API fact)
the task judge materially depends on that post-freeze knowledge
eligibilityPolicy.mixed: task depends on both pre-freeze and post-freeze knowledge that cannot be cleanly separated without changing the judge
eligibilityPolicy.ineligible: core knowledge present at freeze, card is a rewrite of frozen knowledge, knowledge authority is a different skill, or provenance is insufficient
eligibilityPolicy.relativeToFreeze: before = card id present in the frozen skill tree; after = absent from the frozen tree AND first-introduction commit is not an ancestor of the freeze commit (tree membership is authoritative, not the commit timestamp)
eligibilityPolicy.primary: primaryTasks contains exactly the candidates classified clean-holdout; task selection was outcome-blind
